name: typecheck
run: node -e "const f=require('fs'),c=require('child_process');let r=0;const run=(cmd)=>{try{c.execSync(cmd,{stdio:'inherit'})}catch(e){r=1}};if(f.existsSync('web/package.json'))run('npm --prefix web run typecheck');if(f.existsSync('pyproject.toml'))run('uv run mypy ingest --strict');process.exit(r)"

name: test
run: node -e "const f=require('fs'),c=require('child_process'),p=require('path');const tmp=f.mkdtempSync(p.join(process.cwd(),'.tmp','systemtemp-'));const env={...process.env,TEMP:tmp,TMP:tmp};let r=0;const run=(cmd)=>{try{c.execSync(cmd,{stdio:'inherit',env})}catch(e){r=1}};if(f.existsSync('web/package.json'))run('npm --prefix web test');if(f.existsSync('tests'))run('uv run pytest -q');process.exit(r)"
